correctness.rationale: The claim is finite and exhaustively reconstructed. The verifier builds the 16-word GF(4) MDS code, derives all forbidden triples and quadruples directly from IPP1 and IPP2, checks every one of the 65536 subcodes, and independently recomputes the twenty affine-line intersections of all 48 maxima. The replay terminates normally with exact asserted totals; no timeout, heuristic, or unproved infinite extrapolation enters the claim.

value.rationale: The invariant is motivated by the first nonbinary alphabet immediately beyond the unique ternary prolific length-four MDS example. It gives a sharp structural deletion threshold—half of the ambient MDS code must be removed—and a complete finite extremal census with two distinct affine incidence profiles. This is a natural boundary measurement of the IPP obstruction, not an arbitrary slice or a recomputation of a published table.
